title: Stacey–Roberts submersion for sigma-compact mapping sources and smoothly paracompact Banach targets
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The pushforward chart must simultaneously linearize a Banach submersion over a noncompact sigma-compact mapping source. The proof constructs compatible vertical/horizontal local additions using anchored sprays and parameter-smooth parallel transport, then controls the compact-support section chart; a pointwise submersion or ordinary inverse-function argument does not suffice.
author: Peter Kristel; Alexander Schmeding
